checks.检查复合键: select firm,year from raw group by firm,year having count(*)!=1 or firm is null or year is null

stages.name: 2 匹配相邻年度
sql: create table base as select a.*,b.revenue prior from raw a left join raw b on a.firm=b.firm and cast(b.year as integer)=cast(a.year as integer)-1

checks.行数一致: select count(*) from base having count(*)!=(select count(*) from raw)

stages.name: 3 判定基期可用性
sql: create table qc as select *,case when prior is null then '上年无记录' when prior*1.0=0 then '上年收入为零' else '可算' end reason from base

stages.name: 4 构造增长率和样本
sql: create table analysis as select *,case when reason='可算' then 1.0*revenue/prior-1 end growth from qc

exports.分析表.csv: select * from analysis order by firm,year

exports.增长统计.csv: select count(growth) n, round(avg(growth)*100,6) mean_percent from analysis
